doctrine.name: Donor Archaeology
doctrine.principle: Never import a feature until the underlying behavioural law is identified.

artifacts.name: Competitive conversation with explicit victory conditions
artifacts.behavioural_law: When a discussion has explicit victory conditions, agents optimise arguments instead of consensus.
artifacts.reason: Arena Mode needs adversarial reasoning without changing the souls themselves.
artifacts.notes: Harvest the physics, not the dialogue.

artifacts.name: Environmental tension
artifacts.behavioural_law: Rooms feel alive when background risk changes how characters interpret ordinary actions.
artifacts.reason: World state already changes council mood; environmental tension can make empty rooms carry operational meaning.

artifacts.name: Relationship-driven interruptions
artifacts.behavioural_law: Friends and rivals should interrupt at different rates because relationship pressure changes turn-taking.
artifacts.reason: Useful for making council friction emerge from relationships instead of prompt instructions.
artifacts.notes: Future rule: friends +20%, rivals +45%, Oracle override only.

reports.behavioural_law: Rooms feel alive when background risk changes how characters interpret ordinary actions.
reports.calling_card: Boss, I got us more loot. Environmental tension is now in the stack.
reports.duck_observation: The duck watched the entire operation.
